ratios.label: Net margin
ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: the revenue for H1 2026 is not in the statement file (only the profit is), so no margin can be built for the period the net_profit belongs to. The earlier figure was the margin of a different period.

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: earnings are reported in USD but the security is listed and priced in ZAR; a multiple across two currencies is not a ratio. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so all are withheld. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
